# GlowLoox

> GlowLoox is a free salon, spa and beauty appointment booking platform in India. Customers discover and book verified salons, barbershops, spas, makeup artists and skin & derma clinics near them. Booking is free with no hidden charges — pay at the salon.

## What GlowLoox does
- Find nearby salons, barbershops, spas, makeup artists and skin clinics across India
- See real service menus with transparent upfront prices
- Book an appointment slot or join a live walk-in queue
- Read and leave verified reviews
- Free to use for customers — no booking fees, no hidden charges, pay at the salon

## For business owners
- GlowLoox Partner lets salon and barbershop owners manage bookings, services, staff, customers and reviews from a free dashboard (web + Android app)
- Owners list their services and prices, accept bookings, and manage their walk-in queue

## Key facts
- Name: GlowLoox
- Category: Beauty & wellness appointment booking (Lifestyle)
- Country served: India
- Pricing: Free for customers; pay at salon
- Website: https://glowloox.com
- Contact: glowloox@gmail.com
- Business types covered: Salon, Barbershop, Spa & Wellness, Makeup & Bridal, Skin & Derma
